$comment: Runtime config for this landing. This file is served as-is from the public folder and is fetched by the page on every load, so editing it changes the landing WITHOUT a rebuild. Reload the page (or let the dev watcher pick it up) and the landing re-renders.

game.$comment: spins.*.result — per-column icon numbers (1-10), 3 columns x 3 rows on both breakpoints; winLine — winning row (0-2) per column, or null. winAnimation: 'line' | 'border'. bets — values switched by the -/+ arrows, betIndex — the starting one.

assets.$comment: Values are either a built-in key (a filename under src/assets/img or src/assets/sound, no extension) or a URL. A URL starting with / , ./ , http:// or https:// is used verbatim, so you can drop custom art into the public folder and point at it here.

dev.$comment: watch polls this file and re-renders the landing in place when it changes. menu enables the config editor panel — it ships in production builds too, where it saves edits to this browser's localStorage only (use "Скачати" to export a config.json to deploy).
